title: ATLAS per-target scan report
description: Response body of GET /api/atlas/scan/{id}/report. Each item is a taxonomy parent (title) with a taxonomy child (profile.category) plus NVD CVE data.

format.description: Report schema version. Bump invalidates cached reports; consumers should ignore unknown fields.

classifier.description: Fingerprint of the taxonomy rules used; a change invalidates cached reports.

identifier.description: ATLAS-side scan id generated when the scan was launched. Also accepted as {id} in every scan path.

engagement_id.description: NetActor engagement (scan) id, UUID. Also accepted as {id}.

status.description: Scan status. While not completed, items is empty.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of report generation.

findings_total.description: Findings in the underlying scan (not the number of items).

by_category.description: Item count per taxonomy parent (same keys as /api/atlas/taxonomy).

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems, e.g. a CVE whose NVD record does not match the product claimed by the finding.

items.description: One entry per CVE: parent = taxonomy category (title), child = taxonomy sub-category (profile.category) with the NVD record.

title.description: Parent: a taxonomy parent category, e.g. "افشا غیر مجاز". Always one of the parents returned by /api/atlas/taxonomy.

category.description: Child: the taxonomy sub-category this vulnerability was classified into, e.g. "افشا پسورد". Null only for parents that have no children ("ذخیره سازی غیر مطمئن").

finding_title.description: The scanner's original finding wording, kept next to the classification so nothing is lost.

is_exploit.description: true when the CVE is in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

exploit_added.description: Date the CVE was added to KEV.

cvss_v3_0.description: Base score of the NVD CVSS v3.x metric; null if only a v2 score exists.

mapping_warning.description: Set when the NVD description does not mention the product named in the finding title: the agent may have paired the CVE with the wrong product. Treat the mapping as unverified.

error.description: Present instead of NVD data when the lookup failed (rate limit, network). cve_id is still populated.
